join.question: How do I join the {name} Minecraft server?
join.answer: To join {name}, launch Minecraft and use the server address: {address}. Click "Multiplayer" in the main menu, then "Add Server", paste the address, and click "Done" to save. Then select the server and click "Join Server" to connect.

playersOnline.question: How many players are online on {name}?
playersOnline.answer: Currently, {count, plural, one {# player is} other {# players are}} online on {name} out of a maximum capacity of {maxPlayers} players. You can view real-time player statistics and historical data on this page.

version.question: What version of Minecraft does {name} support?
version.answerKnown: {name} is running Minecraft version {version}. Make sure your Minecraft client is compatible with this version to join the server.
version.answerUnknown: {name} supports multiple Minecraft versions. Check the server information above for the current version details.

online.question: Is {name} online and accessible?
online.answer: Yes, {name} is currently monitored every 10 minutes. The latest statistics show the server is {active, select, true {online with active players} other {online}}. Historical uptime and player count data is available on this page.

statistics.question: Can I see player statistics for {name}?
statistics.answer: Yes, this page provides comprehensive statistics for {name} including current player count, maximum players, historical player trends, daily and weekly growth statistics, and server uptime monitoring. Stats are updated every 10 minutes.

edit.detailsSubtitle: Update your server's details, categories, and languages.

claim.dialogDescription: Prove you run this server to take over its listing. Pick the method that fits you.

motd.title: MOTD verification
motd.subtitle: Add a token to your server's MOTD — works for any server (Java, Bedrock, IP or domain).

dns.title: DNS verification
dns.subtitle: You control the server's domain — no player-facing change.
dns.unavailable: Unavailable: this server has no domain (bare IP).

manual.title: Manual request
manual.subtitle: Can't use the above? Send us proof and our team reviews it.

status.pendingManual: You already have a manual request awaiting review for this server.

motd.intro: Add this text anywhere in your server's MOTD (server.properties → motd), reload the server, then click Verify.
motd.hint: The token can sit next to your normal MOTD text. You can remove it once verified.

dns.intro: Add the following TXT record to your domain's DNS, then click Verify.
dns.hint: DNS changes can take a few minutes to propagate. If verification fails, wait and try again.

manual.intro: Tell us how we can confirm you own this server (Discord tag, domain email, etc.). Add a proof link if you have one.
manual.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. I'm the server admin, Discord: name#0000, domain email owner@…

pending.title: Not verified yet
pending.motd: We couldn't find the token in your MOTD. Make sure you saved it and reloaded the server.
pending.dns: The TXT record isn't visible yet. DNS changes can take a few minutes to propagate.

banner.title: This server isn't claimed — is it yours?
banner.subtitle: Verify ownership to manage its listing and earn a verified badge.

success.verifiedBody: You are now the confirmed owner of this server.
success.manualBody: Thanks! Our team will review your request shortly.
